subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------TR.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 97 ((AF)D-25). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TR-INFO (trans-information) is the partner. From the subject: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and AFL (affinity alignment). From RT-INT-TR: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From AFL: TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics). From TH-CONT-DY: ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: AF-CON (affinity convergence). From AF-CON: INTR (interpretation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
